pages.text: [#](53341a)Feed it a sapling and it renders the wood down into a fume, caught in a clay jar — each tree gives a different essence.[#]()
pages.title: What the Oven Makes

pages.text: [#](53341a)Start with what lies to hand: **Wood Ash** from any log, **Exhale** from an oak, **Breath** from a birch.[#]()
[#](53341a)The Hawthorn and Rowan come later, once Herbology gives you Mutandis and the Rowan tree.[#]()
[#](53341a)A **Hawthorn Sapling** bakes into Odour of Purity — the **Brews & Infusions** reagent. Hawthorn comes from Herbology's Mutandis, so this fume waits a chapter.[#]()
pages.title: Odour of Purity

pages.text: [#](53341a)A **Birch Sapling** gives Breath of the Goddess — the **Distilling** reagent, and the base of countless brews.[#]()
pages.title: Breath of the Goddess

pages.text: [#](53341a)A **Rowan Sapling** gives Whiff of Magic — the **Circle Magic** reagent. Rowans come with Herbology, so this waits a little too.[#]()
pages.title: Whiff of Magic

pages.text: [#](53341a)An **Oak Sapling** gives Exhale of the Horned One, used in Mutandis and darker workings.[#]()
pages.title: Exhale of the Horned One

pages.text: [#](53341a)Any **log** smolders down to charcoal, always leaving wood ash — fuel and reagent both.[#]()
pages.title: Charcoal & Wood Ash
